extensions.scope: Home page only: tokens on .home (light) and .dark .home (dark) in src/app/global.css as --home-*; component styles in src/app/(home)/home.css. Documentation pages use Fumadocs' neutral theme with Inter. CSS variables in component snippets resolve only inside the .home scope.

body.purpose: Base reading text and section ledes.

label.purpose: Legend, result group labels, footer hints.

data.purpose: Package names; JetBrains Mono for data only.

data-sm.purpose: Tags, chips, suggestions, keys, version labels.

motion.name: home-ease

motion.value: inner ring ~100s per revolution; 15% speed under pointer
motion.purpose: The one authored, continuous moment; paused off-screen, static under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The home page is a calm graphite instrument with one moving part: a slowly turning orbital map of every documented release, and a search field held in front of it. Each ecosystem is an elliptical ring, each package or project a body on it, each documented version a small moon. The search field is the page's one control, and when a reader types, the map answers: matching bodies light up and the rest dim. Everything below the hero restates the map as plain, ruled text a reader can scan and a screen reader can read.

The surface is cool, technical and quiet: near-black graphite (dark is the default theme) or cool paper in light, hairline rules instead of boxes, one teal accent, and colour reserved for the ecosystems the map is about. Density is moderate: generous section gaps, tight rows inside a list. Depth is soft and rare; only things that float (the search field, its results, preview windows, the tooltip) lift off the ground.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals with a single signal-teal accent; ecosystem hues mark shapes, never text.
Three faces with fixed jobs: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Onest for reading and controls, JetBrains Mono for data only.
Ruled lists over cards; panels only for things that float or frame a preview.
One authored motion moment, the orbit; everything else is a short, single entrance.
Every state readable without scripts and without motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent on the page. If something needs to stand out and it is not focus, a match, the latest release or a forward link, it gets weight or size, not colour.

rules.name: The Shapes, Not Words Rule
rules.body: Ecosystem hues fill dots, bodies, moons and ring strokes. Text beside them is always Frost Ink or Steel Muted, and every coloured mark has a text equivalent (a legend label, or a screen-reader-only ecosystem name in the catalogue).

rules.name: The Token-Only Surface Rule
rules.body: The browser's own surfaces (selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring) and the canvas read their colours from the tokens; the map re-reads them when the theme changes.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for package names, versions, URLs, commands, code and counts, nothing else. Headings, buttons with words on them and prose stay in Onest or Bricolage.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline faces track negative (-0.04em to -0.01em, never tighter than -0.04em) and balance their lines; text faces keep default tracking.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it sits over something (the map, the page) or frames a preview. Rows, tags, chips and link cards stay flat and separate by border or tone.

rules.name: The Hollow and Dashed Rule
rules.body: Hollow means project; dashed means not released yet. Never use either for decoration.

rules.name: The One Orbit Rule
rules.body: The map is the only continuous motion on the page. New motion is a single, short response to arrival or input, never a second loop.

rules.name: The Visible-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content is hidden for an entrance only after scripts run; with no scripts or with reduced motion, everything is already in place.

dos: Do take every colour from the `--home-*` tokens, in both themes, including canvas strokes, selection, caret, scrollbar and focus.
Do keep text on Frost Ink, Steel Muted or Steel Faint; check new pairs against Graphite Ground and Graphite Panel at 4.5:1 or more.
Do give every coloured or drawn mark a text equivalent: a legend label, a screen-reader name, or the catalogue row that restates the map.
Do mark unreleased lines dashed and projects hollow wherever versions or entries are drawn.
Do use JetBrains Mono for package names, versions, URLs, commands, code and counts, with tabular numerals.
Do ship a reduced-motion state and a no-script state with every new animation.
donts: Don't set text in an ecosystem colour, or let colour alone distinguish an ecosystem.
Don't add a second accent or a second continuous animation.
Don't turn the catalogue into a grid of boxed cards; rows are separated by hairlines.
Don't put a shadow on a surface that does not float or frame a preview.
Don't use monospace for headings, prose or button labels.
Don't apply these tokens or faces to the documentation pages; they keep Fumadocs' neutral theme and Inter until their own ADR.
